evidence.description: The appendix describes itself as institutional details and supplemental analyses for main-paper results.
evidence.quote:
This appendix provides institutional details on the regulatory reporting of insider
trades and supplemental analyses to the main results presented in “The Governance Effect of
the Media’s News Dissemination Role: Evidence from Insider Trading”. We summarize the
content of the appendix on the next page. Each page number in parentheses is in relation to
the position in the paper where the relevant content is cross-referenced.

SEC investigation indicator                            SEC Investigation             Dummy variable that equals one if the firm is investigated by the SEC in a year.                                             RavenPack

evidence.description: Appendix IA1 retains multiple dependent-variable, clustering, and sample-threshold specifications.
evidence.quote:
In Table IA1, we run robustness tests with varying dependent variables in Models (1)
to (4) using market-adjusted returns (ReturnADJ), index-based alpha (AlphaIndex), three-month
alpha (Alpha90), and the product of trade size and alpha (Trade Size×Alpha). We cluster
standard errors by year in Model (5), by industry in Model (6), by insider in Model (7), and
by firm and year in Model (8). In Models (9) to (11), we utilize alternative samples by
excluding trivial trades, using as cut-off points trade price (ten dollars), trade volume (1,000
shares), or trade size (10,000 dollars). Our results survive in all of these specifications.

scopes.description: Complete author-documented workflow for the assigned supplement; the package supplies institutional and supplemental analysis documentation only, with no runnable author program or data file.

actions.description: Confirm the appendix-to-paper mapping and obtain the executable author workflow and compatible input specifications.
steps: Ask the authors or package custodian to confirm that the appendix titled The Governance Effect of the Media’s News Dissemination Role is the supplement intended for the frozen title and DOI in this assignment.
Request the runnable author programs and run instructions, including every entry point, required runtime/software, stages and their producer-consumer order for the main-paper and appendix analyses.

Request a complete specification of author-prepared analysis files or compatible source products, including format, fields, identifiers, sample coverage, variable construction, and author-supported acquisition routes. Clarify how the cited RavenPack and Thomson Reuters/CRSP measures are supplied or prepared; do not infer licensing or data availability from their names.

Retain all stated appendix variants, including the alternate outcomes, clustering schemes, sample thresholds, stale-news tests, impact/recency analyses, routine-trader variants, and SEC/litigation analyses.
validation: After identity is confirmed and materials are supplied, inventory all program entry points and map the main results and Appendix Tables IA1–IA5 to their generating scripts, branches, and required supporting stages.

Review dependency closure and data construction order; verify required input fields, identifiers, and stated periods against bounded metadata for each author-supplied or author-identified compatible input before any separately authorized execution.

review_notes: No analysis_only scope is supported: the package contains no author-prepared dataset or executable analysis entry point from which a separate route and its compatible inputs can be verified.

The supplied appendix includes some variable source labels and a transaction-period statement; these are documentation evidence and do not alone establish live raw-data dependencies or a verified acquisition route.
